page: Elysia ergonomic web framework for Bun. TypeScript-first design with type safety. Simple hello world example at localhost:3000. Dynamic path parameters like :id. HTTP methods: GET, POST. Request body handling. JSON response serialization. Performance benchmarks: 255,574.717 requests/second average, outperforms most frameworks, matches Golang/Rust frameworks. Built on Bun with JIT compilation. WinterTC compliance. Eden client library for end-to-end type safety. Production deployment across multiple runtimes. Community-driven development since 2022. Used by 10,000+ GitHub projects. Questions: What is Elysia and why use it? How performant is Elysia compared to other frameworks? What TypeScript features does Elysia provide? How do I use path parameters? How do I set up end-to-end type safety with clients?

sections.manifest: Elysia performance metrics and optimization. Average 255,574.717 requests/second vs competing frameworks. Bun 262,660.433, Hono 203,937.883, Express 15,913.153 on Node. Static code analysis and JIT compilation for optimization. Benchmark tested on Debian 11, Intel i7-13700K, Bun 0.7.2. TechEmpower Benchmark round 22 comparison. Framework comparison: bun, hyper-express, hono, h3, oak, fastify, koa, express across runtimes. Questions: How fast is Elysia? What frameworks does Elysia compare against? How is performance measured?

TypeScript integration and automatic type inference. Elysia infers types from code without explicit declarations. Path parameters automatically typed at compile and runtime. id parameter type inference from :id. Types without manual TypeScript annotations. Type safety at both runtime and compile time. Help developers write less TypeScript. Questions: How does type inference work in Elysia? Do I need to write TypeScript types manually? How are path parameters typed?

Elysia.t schema builder for type validation. Runtime and compile-time type validation. Single source of truth for data types. t.Object() for object validation. t.Number() for number type validation. Path parameter validation with params option. Strict type enforcement. Questions: How do I validate request data? What is Elysia.t? How do I ensure only specific types are accepted?

Standard Schema support for validation libraries. Supports Zod, Valibot, ArkType, Effect Schema, Yup, Joi. Mixed validation: z.object with v.object in same route. z.coerce.number() for type coercion. v.literal() for literal type validation. Type inference from schema automatically. Favorite validation library compatibility. Questions: What validation libraries are supported? Can I mix different validation libraries? How do I use Zod with Elysia?

OpenAPI standard adoption and documentation. Adds openapi() plugin for API documentation. WinterTC compliance. Default OpenAPI support. One-liner documentation generation. Scalar or Swagger documentation pages. Seamless team sharing of API docs. Questions: How do I generate API documentation? What is OpenAPI? Does Elysia support OpenAPI by default?

OpenAPI schema generation from types. fromTypes() function for automatic schema generation. One-line OpenAPI generation from TypeScript types. Similar to FastAPI's automatic OpenAPI. Complete accurate API documentation from code. Unique Elysia feature. No manual annotation needed. Questions: How do I generate OpenAPI without manual annotation? What does fromTypes() do? How is this different from manual OpenAPI?

End-to-end type safety with Eden client library. Synchronize types between backend and frontend automatically. treaty() for type-safe API calls. Export app type with typeof app. eden import for client-side. Type inference on client without code generation. Similar to tRPC approach. Client-server type synchronization. Questions: How do I set up end-to-end type safety? What is Eden? How do I export server types to clients?

Type soundness for all API outcomes including errors. Type inference for all possible outcomes from lifecycle events/macros. Error status codes typed (401, 420). Macro system for auth patterns. beforeHandle for validation patterns. status() function for typed responses. Type-safe error and success handling. Questions: How does Elysia handle error types? What are macros? How are all outcomes typed?

Platform agnostic deployment across runtimes. WinterTC compliance enables multi-runtime support. Runtimes: Bun, Node.js, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Expo, Next.js, Astro. Optimized for Bun but not limited to Bun. API route integration capabilities. Questions: What runtimes does Elysia support? Is Elysia Bun-only? How do I deploy to different platforms?
